holds.HOLD>OP.cost.quote: were transferred to the Target Company at a consideration of approximately RMB123,947,000 in February 2022 (the “Reorganisation”) and the Project Companies became the wholly-owned subsidiaries of the Target Company upon completion of the Reorganisation.

flows.exit.indirect_cn_target.quote: The Target Company holds the entire equity interests in each of the Project Companies
flows.exit.indirect_cn_target.formula: the BVI company holds all the equity of four Mainland project companies: transferring the BVI shares is an indirect transfer of Mainland taxable property (公告2015年第7号 Article 1)

flows.exit.cn_value_ratio.formula: appraised values: long-term equity investments 42,047.36 ÷ total assets 42,052.48 (RMB ten thousand) = 99.99% (公告2015年第7号 Article 4(1) looks at the share of the foreign enterprise's equity value derived from Chinese taxable property)

flows.exit.cn_asset_ratio.formula: book values: long-term equity investments 12,394.73 ÷ total assets 12,399.85 (RMB ten thousand) = 99.96% (公告2015年第7号 Article 4(2) looks at the asset composition)

flows.exit.limited_functions_and_risks.quote: It is a newly established company with no substantial business operations at present.
flows.exit.limited_functions_and_risks.formula: the valuation report says the BVI company is a holding platform with no substantive operations (pdf 60) and had carried on no actual business as at the valuation date (pdf 79) — 公告2015年第7号 Article 4(3)

flows.exit.listed_market_trade.formula: what is transferred is 100% of a BVI limited company, taken up by the sole qualified bidder through a public listing-for-sale (pdf 8), not a public market trade in listed shares

present.HOLD.quote: The Target Company is a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands with limited liability

present.exit_route.quote: Under the Disposal, Yunnan Water (Hong Kong) has agreed to sell, and Global Environment Investment has agreed to acquire, 100% interest in the Target Company.

event.exit.quote: The Consideration of the Disposal is RMB296,259,700, which was determined and equivalent to the appraised value of the Disposal Interest as at 31 December 2021 by an independent PRC valuer

event.on.quote: The Consideration was paid by Global Environment Investment on 3 November 2022.

company_estimate.quote: The estimated tax effect of the Disposal amounted to RMB11,215,000 represents the PRC enterprise income tax calculated based on a tax rate of 10% on taxable disposal gain arising from the transfer of equity interests in the Project Companies
company_estimate.use: for comparison only: 10% corresponds to taxable income of about RMB112.15m, i.e. deductions of about RMB184.11m; the circular does not disclose the revenue and deductions used, and the seller's cost of the BVI shares is not disclosed as an amount either

notes: Source: Yunnan Water Investment (6839.HK) circular of 2023-02-24 (cases/sources/K4-yunnanwater-2023/source.pdf). A Hong Kong company sells the BVI company holding four Mainland project companies: an indirect transfer of Mainland taxable property.

The four project companies are combined into OP (the BVI company holds 100% of each, and their aggregate appraised value equals its long-term equity investments); the listed parent (a Mainland joint stock company) above the seller is not modelled.

The BVI company is outside the three jurisdictions: the tax of the existing structure is evaluated directly on the existing structure; the planner's candidates place intermediate holding companies only in the Mainland, Hong Kong and Singapore.
